nom: SEKKISEI Herbal UV Defense Gel Broad Spectrum SPF 40 Sunscreen

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe it as lightweight, non-greasy, and mattifying through the day, including in hot, humid climates.
segments.dry: The few reviewers with dry skin say it nourishes and absorbs well without leaving a white cast.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including dry-and-oily T-zone combinations, report it balances both areas without shine or breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin consistently report no irritation or breakouts, describing it as gentle and comfortable to wear.

concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin describe the gel finish as mattifying and non-greasy, even in hot, humid conditions, without feeling heavy.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report their skin feels hydrated throughout the day, without the tight or dry sensation some sunscreens leave.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight gel that layers well under makeup

extraits.texte: I was gifted by sekkiseius in exchange for a review. I love trying different sunscreens and I've tried a ton. This is super lightweight on the skin and I love how easy it is to apply. Unfortunately for me, ir leaves a dewy finish which I don't love, but I gave this to my friend and she really enjoys it. If you like a dewy finish, this is for you!

I received this Herbal UV Defense Gel complimentary from sekkiseius in exchange for my honest review. It has a pleasant gel formula that absorbs easily into my skin and feels very lightweight and comfortable. Perfect for those with oily and/or combination skin like myself! It also has no white cast (although I am fairly to begin with, so can't speak to how it looks on darker skin tones), and it had a nice finish that left my skin feeling soft and hydrated without any greasiness. There is some fragrance to it which could be an issue for those with fragrance sensitivities. It didn't bother me, but I think it's unnecessary for this type of product. I also noticed that the packaging says it can be used for face and body. While this may feel great on the skin for a body sunscreen, I don't think this small bottle will go very far if you use it that way, so I'm planning to only use it for face/neck. This is a great everyday sunscreen to incorporate into my daily skincare routine, but you will want to consider that it is not waterproof/sweatproof, so it is best suited for daily wear rather than beach and sports days.

SEKKISEI Is a new brand to me but not a new brand. They feature Japanese skin care products and this one contains some powerhouse ingredients. The Herbal UV Defense Gel Broad Spectrum SPF 40 Sunscreen goes on easily, it absorbs well and doesn't leave any kind of noticeable residue (aka It doesn't leave any white spots). I have very oily skin which is prone to acne and this works well for my skin. My skin is also very pale and I am prone to sunburn so the SPF 40 is great. The herbal sunscreen contains Job's Tears Extract which which helps to moisturize the skin and provide antioxidant benefits. It also contains Licorice Root Extract which I love for its anti-inflammatory properties given my proneness to breaking out. The aloe vera extract is great for providing additional moisturization. I have been using the product in place of my traditional moisturizer and it's working very well for me. This product was gifted by sekkisei. us in exchange for my honest opinion.

extraits.titre: Perfect SPF 40 Primer for Sensitive, Combination S
extraits.texte: I was gifted the Herbal UV Defense Gel Broad Spectrum SPF 40 Sunscreen by Sekkisei, and it leaves my skin looking youthful and healthy. I use it daily as the perfect primer for my makeup, and it works beautifully for my combination-sensitive skin. The lightweight formula is enriched with ingredients to hydrate, brighten, and soothe while providing protection against UVA/UVB rays. This gel absorbs quickly with no heavy or greasy sensation, evens out my skin tone, and leaves absolutely no white cast, making me feel confident using it every day!

I have sensitive skin, and this sunscreen works good for me. I love how soothing it feels on the skin. It is hydrating and moisturizing, and it also helps brighten my complexion. The texture is lightweight and fast-absorbing. It applies smoothly and blends perfectly. It is not greasy, sticky, or tacky. It doesn't pill under makeup and leaves no white cast. It feels comfortable on the skin throughout the day. Complimentary from SEKKISEIUS.

I live in Houston where it's hot and humid most of the year, and this UV Gel SPF 40 has worked really well for my oily skin. I prefer gel sunscreens because they feel lightweight and don't leave my face greasy. This one absorbs quickly, sits comfortably under makeup, and doesn't make me feel shiny by midday. So far, it's been a great option for everyday sun protection.
